items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: He used to come to his house on Sundays and then we'd come down from Death Strand and then we'd take lessons. He'd give us lessons.

ctx.x: But did you do that at his house or did he come to your house?

No he come to Central Road. The trumpet player, or El Vinnett out of Central Road. He used to come to his house on Sundays and then we'd come down from Death Strand and then we'd take lessons. He'd give us lessons.
Do you remember how he would teach? Did he have a method book for everybody in the band or what did he do?
